# Attio — Startup Program

80% off the annual Pro plan plus credits in year one and 30% off in year two, for workspaces of up to 10 seats, with dedicated onboarding and third-party perks (3 months of Linear, 6 months of Notion).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🤝 CRM & Sales](../categories/crm.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Must apply within 90 days of creating an Attio workspace: "Yes, you can apply within your first 90 days of creating a workspace." |
| **When it ends** | 30% off the second year |


### Not covered

- workspaces over 10 seats

> **Stacking:** Program includes third-party perks (Mercury, Linear, Notion, Intercom, Sentry, Apollo, Miro) via an in-program catalogue.

confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Two eligibility statements on the same page differ slightly: the partners section says "To qualify for the Startup Program, you must be venture backed or affiliated with one of our startup partners" (an OR), while the FAQ states the conservative, stricter form: "Startups that meet all the following criteria: VC-backed, signed up within the last 90 days, and incorporated less than 10 years ago." Gates follow the FAQ. Seat cap: "This discount is valid for workspaces of up to 10 seats." Eligibility quoted verbatim: "Startups that meet all the following criteria: VC-backed, signed up within the last 90 days, and incorporated less than 10 years ago." and "This discount is valid for workspaces of up to 10 seats." Year two is "30% off the second year".
